blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Super Typhoon Rosal slightly weakened on Wednesday afternoon, Oct. 21, as it moved west-northwestward east of Aparri, Cagayan, the state weather bureau said. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), in its 5 p.m. weather advisory, reported that Rosal’s eye was located 725 kilometers (450 miles) east of Aparri as of 4 p.m. Rosal had maximum sustained winds of 205 kph (127 mph) near its center and gusts of up to 250 kph (155 mph). Strong to typhoon-force winds extended up to 780 kilometers (485 miles) from the center. Pagasa said Rosal would continue moving west-northwestward […]...
